current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation list for planning' page (https://www.slough.gov.uk/local-validation-list/local-validation-list-planning-applications), reached from Grokbot's hub link, states the list was 'formally adopted by the council on 1 January 2026' and points to the Local Validation List directory, which followed the September 2025 draft consultation.

issues.detail: The status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong. The hub page, the planning list page, the directory categories and the individual requirement records are all public HTML and fetched without problem. Grokbot captured 0 requirements for every application type although it lists 3 docs read. The list is a web directory (one record per requirement, grouped by application type into 'Always required' and 'Often required'), not a PDF, which is probably why extraction failed.
issues.evidence: Directory categories: Householder (category/59), Major (62), Minor (65), Change of use (68), Advertisement (71), Listed building works (74), Demolitions in CA/LB (77), LDC (80), Other types (83)

issues.detail: No householder requirements were captured. The Householder category lists Application form, Block/site plan, Site location plan, Floor plans, Elevations, Roof plans and Fee, plus 'Often required' items: Cross sections; Ecological Survey; Flood risk assessment; Heritage statement and design & access statement; Planning statement or supporting letter; Site levels and finished floor levels; Tree survey (AIA, AMS, Tree Protection Plan), required 'When there are trees or hedges either on the proposed development site or on land adjacent' with trees over 75mm diameter within influencing distance. CIL Form 1 is also listed.
issues.evidence: Category 61 'Often required for householder application validation requirements'; record 35528: 'For trees with a diameter greater than 75 mm within influencing distance ... a Tree Survey/Report will be required'

issues.detail: No major or full planning requirements were captured. The Major category runs to more than 50 items over 2 pages, including: Affordable Housing Statement, Air Quality Assessment, Archaeology Desk Based Assessment, Biodiversity Net Gain Information, Bird Nesting Strategy, Car Parking Management Plan, CEMP, Contaminated Land Assessment, Crime Prevention Statement, Daylight and Sunlight / Microclimate Assessment, Delivery & Servicing Management Plan, Demolition Method Statement, Drainage Assessment (SuDS), Energy Statement, EIA/ES, Financial Viability Assessment, Flood Risk Assessment, Habitats Survey, Health Impact Assessment, Heritage Statement, Land/Slope Stability Report, Landscaping scheme and management, Lighting Assessment, Marketing exercise, Noise assessment, Odour Impact Assessment, Phasing Plan, Refuse and Recycling Strategy, Retail impact assessment, S106 draft heads of terms, Statement of community engagement, Street scene elevations, Structural survey, Telecommunications Report, Townscape/LVIA, Transport assessment/statement and travel plan, Tree Survey, Utilities assessment. Triggers for each sit on the individual record pages and were not captured.

The separate directory categories for Minor applications, Change of use, Listed building works, Demolition in conservation area/listed building, Lawful development certificates, Advertisements and 'Other types' were not captured. All app_type rows read 'Not covered', although the list covers LDCs, prior approvals, discharge of conditions and non-material/minor-material amendments.
issues.evidence: Planning list page: covers 'certificates of lawfulness, prior approval submissions, details to comply with conditions applications, and non-material and minor material amendments'

summary: Grokbot's hub link and adoption date (1 January 2026) are correct and current, but it wrongly marked the list unreadable and captured nothing. The list is a public web directory with dozens of requirements per application type (15 for householder, more than 50 for major), so all of it is missing from the workbook.
